rag.text:
Test: TC-3898 — Feature are - Task - Attributes displaying and editing - Tasks Without Dates - Removing dates from issue view
Priority: Medium | Status: In Review | Type: Manual
Folder: /BP/TS-88 Feature area - Box - Attributes displaying and editing
Labels: teamembers, teamtree

Steps:
1. Navigate to the Gantt module of boxName
   Data: boxName: TC-3898 Feature are - Task - Attributes displaying and editing - Tasks Without Dates - Removing dates from issue view
   Expected: Two Jira tasks are displayed on WBS.
2. Click on issue key of taskName
   Data: taskName: FirstRemovedStartDate
   Expected: New tab with Jira issue view of FirstRemovedStartDate is opened
3. Click on start date field and remove its value
   Expected: The start date of the FirstRemovedStartDate have been removed
4. Go back to Gantt module.
   Expected: On Gantt timeline task FirstRemovedStartDate ends on 18 of November, 2024, and has no start date. On WBS only end date is displayed.
5. Click on issue key of taskName
   Data: taskName: FirstRemovedStartDate
   Expected: New tab with Jira issue view of FirstRemovedStartDate is opened
6. Click on end date field and remove its value
   Expected: The end date of the FirstRemovedStartDate have been removed
7. Go back to Gantt module.
   Expected: On Gantt timeline task FirstRemovedStartDate is not displayed. On WBS start & end dates are empty.
8. Click on issue key of taskName
   Data: taskName: FirstRemovedEndDate
   Expected: New tab with Jira issue view of FirstRemovedEndDate is opened
9. Click on end date field and remove its value
   Expected: The end date of the FirstRemovedEndDate have been removed
10. Go back to Gantt module.
   Expected: On Gantt timeline task FirstRemovedEndDate starts on 18 of November, 2024, and has no end date. On WBS only start date is displayed.
11. Click on issue key of taskName
   Data: taskName: FirstRemovedEndDate
   Expected: New tab with Jira issue view of FirstRemovedEndDate is opened
12. Remove the startDate and click Update
   Expected: The start date of the StartDateRemovedSecond have been removed.
13. Go back to Gantt module.
   Expected: On Gantt timeline task FirstRemovedEndDate is not displayed. On WBS start & end dates are empty
